Triage update (preliminary):
- Reviewed pcap and API logs (attached to internal folder). Seeing TCP-level FIN shortly after the last chunk for several requests; Content-Length on the headers is smaller than the bytes transferred in successive frames — suggests proxy might be coalescing chunks or terminating connections mid-chunk when upstream enters a keepalive window reset.
- Repro on staging with high concurrency shows the same pattern when proxy keepalive timeout = 10s and server heartbeat = 12s.

Immediate asks:
1) Can we increase proxy keepalive and websocket ping interval to 30s for Novus (temporary) — should reduce mid-chunk tear-downs.
2) Add a short-term routing rule to send Novus traffic to the dedicated realtime pool (lower proxy multiplexing).
3) Recommend Novus fallback to long-polling endpoint for critical writes until we confirm fix.

I’m escalating to Marissa to allocate an on-call infra engineer and request emergency capacity for a dedicated pool.
